name: Akaash
greetingText: I wanted to do something special, so I made this for you :)
greetingText1: I honestly don't know what i would do without you...
greetingText2: Thank you for being there through my good days, bad days, stupid decisions,endless talks, and all the crazy moments🤣💖...
greetingText3: You have seen so many versions of me and still stayed--and that means more than I can ever explain..
greetingText4: I just want you to be genuinely happy, successful, peaceful, and surrounded by people who truly love❤ and value you ..
greetingText5: May this year, brings you everything that your heart wishes for💝 ..
greetingText6: No matter how much life changes or how far we go, I hope one thing never changes..
wishText: You are more special than you know. Never forget that. ✨
